name: urna
about: urna.dev's palette, the same one rust/clitui/src/tui/pal.rs draws: the grey ramp tint(l) between #002b36 and #dfe8ea (ground 32 -> #002b36, surface 44 -> #0c3540, raised 58 -> #1a414b, line 84 -> #355861, faint 130 -> #658087, dim 170 -> #8ea3a9, ink 248 -> #dfe8ea), the title gradient #a8dcdc -> #85c8c8 and the thermometer low #c45c54, mid #c9a85c, high #6eb07c.
desc: urna, end to end: urna setup on an empty machine (scan, plan, the offline embedder payload, the python env, the doctor checks), then urna tui: open a corpus, ask it, read the cited answer, check the install, quit.
